The geohash precision was set too coarse, so a single cell spanned several kilometers and returned drivers who were technically inside the cell but too far away to dispatch.
Driver location updates were only re-indexed into the geohash grid once a minute, so the search matched a driver's stale position from before they moved into range.

By adding more dispatch service replicas to handle ride requests, without validating that each replica queries the same up-to-date driver location index.
